_meta.no_deed_text: No Deed Book Found or Provided
_meta.deed_formats: Integrity GIS county viewers use RECORDING ("249/255", "366-538", "2021DR001866", "B: 321 P: 15", "RL22 ~1132") or deed_bkpg ("1063-324", "2024-2804", "0156-000080") or DEEDBOOK1/PAGENO1. Many counties mix book/page and year-number instruments. Jefferson, Franklin, Jackson and Pulaski give instrument/document numbers. Some counties add suffixes (e.g. "251/116-WD", "14-405 (BENEF)").
_meta.plat_formats: Plat book/page only in Jefferson (plat_book/plat_page) and Franklin (SUBD_PLAT_BK_DOC/SUBD_PAGE); elsewhere none.
_meta.excluded_false_hits: Ozark "ozark_parcels" (City of Ozark area, Christian County); "Crawford" parcel layers from Indiana and Pennsylvania; Platte City and Parkville views without owner; GDIT statewide FMDC real estate (state-owned land only).

status_legend.ok: owner+deed+PID live-verified countywide, deed reference filled on at least 50% of parcels
status_legend.partial: owner+PID with no deed, deed under 50%, PID only, or partial-area copy
status_legend.missing: no public countywide owner source found
